Rules.dc.html.title: Rules — Gunline core rules v0.5 (torpedoes, campaign battles)

heading.text: Gunline — capital ship squadron battle mockup

howto.text: Campaign: open the Operation board (right), pick an available mission and press Ready the fleet, then Launch. The battle board loads your saved ships with their damage, crew, criticals and refits, plus the mission's enemies, terrain and objectives (top-left panel). When the mission ends, the debrief writes losses, prizes, credits and renown back to the save; return to the Operation board to repair and refit at drydocks. Without a readied mission the battle board plays a 2v2 skirmish. Controls: click inside the blue zone to plot the selected ship's course and pick an order; double-click plots and moves on, and commits on the last ship. Cruisers can also launch a torpedo with their orders (orange button under the orders). You roll your own dice in the dice tray and decide on boarding when an enemy's shields are down and its hull is below half.
